releases.title: Claude Duet (research preview)
releases.summary: Anthropic's new proactive agent app (iOS, Android and claude.ai), built around Claude Opus 5.5: a morning brief across your connected apps, tasks that keep running when you step away, and approval checks before it sends, pays, signs or deletes. Waitlist research preview for US Pro and Max subscribers, included in those plans' usage limits

releases.title: Recursive Flint (open-weight local coding model)
releases.summary: Recursive's first model: a 40B-parameter mixture-of-experts coding model with about 2.5B active per token, built to run agentic coding on your own laptop (Recursive reports 125+ tokens/s on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro). Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face; works with llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and SGLang

releases.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Embed, Rerank and Parse
releases.summary: New open, commercially usable retrieval models for agents and RAG: Nemotron 3.5 Embed (8B and 1B, text plus document images such as tables and charts), Rerank 8B, and a 631M-parameter Parse model that turns PDFs and scans into structured Markdown and tables. Weights on Hugging Face, plus NVIDIA NIM and partner APIs

releases.title: ElevenLabs Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models
releases.summary: Eleven Realtime v1 Mini (low-cost natural conversation) and v1 Max (reasoning and multi-step tool calls) are complete speech-to-speech voice agents in 90+ languages with any of 17,000+ library voices, available in ElevenAgents and through an OpenAI Realtime API-compatible WebSocket API

releases.title: Perplexity Computer runs fully local on Mac
releases.summary: A new local-first mode in the Perplexity Mac app runs both the model and the agent on the Mac, working with local files and apps like Notes, Messages, Mail and Numbers, even offline; cloud access only when you approve. For Pro, Max and Enterprise subscribers, with Qwen 3.6 and PPLX Pro as local models; Apple silicon with 36GB+ unified memory recommended

releases.title: Mistral Voxtral 3 speech models and voice agent SDK
releases.summary: New speech-to-text models (Voxtral Small and Mini Transcribe 3, plus a realtime model under 500 ms latency, 50+ languages with diarization) and Voxtral Speech 3 text-to-speech (35+ languages), plus a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK; Mistral API from US$0.0035/min for transcription and US$13 per 1M characters for speech, or self-deployed

releases.title: Motion General Video Agent (public beta)
releases.summary: Mosaic's video agent edits your footage into clips, makes launch videos and motion design, can copy a reference video's pacing and style, and exports to Premiere Pro, After Effects and DaVinci Resolve; also has an API and MCP server. Credit-based pricing

releases.title: Amazon Polly Generative engine upgrade
releases.summary: A new model behind Polly's Generative engine gives more natural, accurate low-latency speech (more reliable with numbers, emails and addresses), 14 new voices across nine locales, and Hindi and Finnish support

releases.title: Gemini tools for small business owners (rolling out)
releases.summary: The Gemini app is starting to roll out a business landing page, saved brand styles for on-brand visuals with Nano Banana 2.1, financial charts from messy spreadsheets and receipts, and connections to Google Business Profile, Google Ads, Workspace and apps like Canva, Shopify, Wix and Xero, for all Gemini app users globally over the coming days

releases.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
releases.summary: Faster, cheaper agent and coding model: MiniMax says agentic task costs drop 70% versus its predecessor, with 200+ tokens/s output; US$0.15 input / US$0.60 output per 1M tokens via MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code (weights later)

releases.title: Inception Mercury 3 (diffusion LLM)
releases.summary: Inception's largest diffusion LLM: 1,000+ tokens/s, 1M-token context, OpenAI-compatible API on Inception, OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel; launch price US$0.10 input / US$0.35 output per 1M tokens

releases.title: Cloudflare Clairic extraction model (preview)
releases.summary: New Workers AI model that returns typed values (text spans, numbers, dates, estimates, forecasts) with confidence scores instead of generated text; US$0.10 per 1M input tokens, open weights planned

releases.title: Gemini Notebook: steer slides and video overviews
releases.summary: Gemini Notebook now suggests topics from your sources and lets you review the outline or producer notes before it renders a Slide Deck or Video Overview; rolling out to all users over the week

releases.title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 and open Search API
releases.summary: New V4.1 Flash checkpoint on web, app and API (same deepseek-flash name and price), faster and shorter outputs; DeepSeek's in-house search API opened to developers

releases.title: Reflection Beam (open weights)
releases.summary: Reflection's first open-weight model: sparse MoE (501B total, 23B active) for coding and agents, Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, plus the open-source Mirror CLI

releases.title: ChatGPT Slides and faster GPT-6 Pro with parallel agents
releases.summary: Create, co-edit, present and export decks (PowerPoint, PDF, Google Slides) in ChatGPT Space for Pro, Business and Enterprise; GPT-6 Pro gets faster replies and parallel agents

releases.title: OpenAI prompt-to-voice for all API customers
releases.summary: Describe a voice in text to create a custom voice for GPT-Live sessions (creation is free), plus nine new GPT-Live voices

releases.title: Kling 4.0 officially launched
releases.summary: Kling AI's new video model: native 30-second generation, steadier motion and camera moves, Omni Reference with up to 15 references and 10 keyframes; API coming soon

releases.title: StepFun Step 5 Preview (open weights)
releases.summary: 600B-parameter sparse MoE (27B active) with a 1M-token context, built for long agentic tasks; BF16 and FP8 weights on Hugging Face

releases.title: Meta Muse Spark Open (open weights)
releases.summary: Open-weight multimodal MoE model (816B total, 42B active, 1M context) for coding and agents

releases.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt
releases.summary: Open 120B multimodal agent model plus a 24GB local Bolt model

releases.title: Claude Code Review generally available
